transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As Safety Officer, I'm convening this incident-response review for the B-14 forklift battery overheating event at Dock 2. Dock 2 will remain closed until I'm satisfied we have the right safety controls in place for a controlled reopening. In the meantime, the warehouse needs to keep processing outbound orders from the other docks, so let's work through this efficiently. I need current findings from each of your areas: maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing. Let's start with maintenance — what do you have so far on B-14 and the charging station at Dock 2?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share my inspection findings. B-14 has internal cell damage — it must be removed from the charger and isolated in the steel battery cabinet for exactly 24 hours before any disposition. I've recorded this in the maintenance log, but I hadn't yet updated this incident channel until now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Here are my warehouse logistics findings. My dock inventory check found exactly 18 outbound pallets currently blocking the safe access route at Dock 2. They must be moved to staging lane S-4 before reopening. I confirmed the lane assignment on the floor map, but dispatch has not yet updated its board, so we'll need to make sure that gets synced up.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Here are my fire protection findings. My thermal scan found heat damage at charger C-12, which is on the same circuit as the B-14 incident. C-12 must be de-energized for exactly 6 hours. Additionally, a fire watch must be maintained for exactly 4 hours after Dock 2 is reopened. I completed the thermal scan during the response, but I want to note that the fire-protection log is not yet signed — I'll get that completed as part of this process.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Here are my training and staffing findings. My certification review found that the scheduled night forklift operator, Tom, lacks current battery-emergency training. Elena is the only currently qualified substitute for the night shift. I completed the review for tonight's roster, but the staffing board still shows Tom, so that needs to be corrected before the night shift begins.
transcript.speaker: A5
